SUBJ/DOD COMEX 25-2 SITUATIONAL AWARENESS INFORMATION BROADCAST//  
GENTEXT/REMARKS/1. EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE.  
At the national level, communications systems remain operational  
with no reported outages or areas of concern.  All Auxiliarists are  
encouraged to monitor the Space Weather Prediction Center dashboards  
and WWV/H at :18 and :45 minutes past the hour for solar updates.  
  
2. Auxiliarists are reminded to sign in at WWW.DODMARS.ORG.  
  
3. Only Auxiliarists who have a change in their NCMARSSTAT station  
status or those who did not submit a status in June should complete  
the RI and forward to Granite Wolf.  
  
4. Continue to monitor your local news outlets and local/regional  
communications networks.  Be prepared to report communication  
outages lasting longer than 12 hours to Granite Wolf.  
  
5. Continue normal net schedules and operations with a focus on  
ensuring all Auxiliarists receive this broadcast message.  With the  
exception of disseminating these broadcast messages, updates to the  
NCMARSTAT, and communication outage reporting in accordance with 4  
above, there should be minimal other digital traffic on the nets and  
no other traffic going to Granite Wolf.  
  
6. Auxiliarists be prepared to receive and execute the semi-annual  
key change.  Anticipate the TAK server credential will also change.  
  
7. Remain vigilant and prepared to respond.  
  
EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE
